prompt: In the rich, textured style of an oil painting, a sun-drenched botanical greenhouse reveals a lively scene. On the left, a woman in a yellow hat stands beside a tall fern, her posture upright and attentive. Next to her, a small boy in blue overalls points eagerly at a vibrant orchid blooming on a wooden shelf. The orchid, with its delicate purple petals, sits securely in a terracotta pot. In the center, an elderly man with a white beard sits on a rustic wooden bench, his hands resting gently on his knees. Beside him, a tabby cat sleeps curled up, its fur blending with the warm tones of the wood. To the right, a gardener in green coveralls waters a large monstera plant, the water streaming from a copper watering can. The monstera’s broad leaves dominate the foreground, their deep green hues contrasting with the glass ceiling above. Near the back wall, a girl in a pink dress looks at a butterfly perched on a leaf, her expression one of quiet wonder. The butterfly, with orange and black wings, remains still under her gaze. A wicker basket filled with gardening tools rests on the floor next to the gardener, its handle slightly askew. Finally, a stone statue of a cherub stands in the far corner, partially obscured by hanging ivy, adding a classical touch to the verdant space. There is no modern technology visible in this timeless setting. There is no artificial lighting fixture, only natural light filtering through the glass panes.
